The 2014 spectral paper establishes the sufficient instability mechanism, not density-dependent profile geometry. Priority remains conditional on wider literature and the elementary derivability of the new result is explicitly acknowledged.
residual_risks: The published source gives the complete underlying function; historical mathematical priority for the new calculus classification remains provisional.

value.rationale: The complete double-turning criterion and a fully certified finite-degree counterexample show that degree-based early-invasion screening can have disconnected vulnerable bands even without degree correlations. This is a motivated limitation of ranking patches solely by connectivity, identifies the return-probability mechanism, and is neither a tiny arbitrary parameter computation nor a claim about exact outbreak probabilities.
